title: A scenario: everything needed to set up and judge one game
description: data/scenarios/<slug>.json, id scenario:<slug>. Blocks follow 59.12 (a-h). A scenario that extends another takes every block it does not give. Abstraction blocks (59.6 and each group's x.9 / x.7 cases) replace the named side blocks when that module is abstracted.

through.description: The named side holds the Initiative until the end of this OpStage; from the next, the normal rule (7.0)

abstractions.description: Keyed by which modules are abstracted: air (Land and Logistics Games), air_and_logistics (Land Game only), logistics (Land and Air Games)

placement.description: Where a block may be placed. At least one locator (hexes, place, box, within, region, sheets, west_of, air_facility, stacked_with); where several are given, a hex must satisfy every one (region with sheets is that country's part of those sheets). A list inside a locator is a choice: any of its hexes, places or sheets. not_within, apart, together and constraint narrow it.

hexes.description: Any of these hexes, divided as the owner likes (59.2)

place.description: A data/map/places.json id, every hex of it; a list is every hex of any of them, divided as the owner likes

west_of.description: Hexes west of this one: on an earlier sheet (A-E run west to east), or on its sheet with a lower column CC. A column bound, so a hex in the same column is not west of it

apart.description: Each entry of the block (a listed unit with everything it brings) at least this many hexes from every other entry (R-136, 61.41)

together.description: Every unit, dump or supply unit of the block goes into one hex, chosen by the owner within the placement

stacked_with.description: Any hex holding a unit of this kind once the rest of the side's set-up is placed (R-135, Rommel)

constraint.description: Our sentence for what the grammar cannot say; a ruling should follow

motorisation.description: How truck points become motorisation points (32.5, 59.63)

from.description: Each truck point of these classes is one motorisation point: in reinforcements and replacements, and in the starting trucks (first- and second-line blocks alike) unless unattached is given

unattached.description: Starting unattached motorisation points where the scenario prints them; these replace the second-line truck blocks

unitEntry.description: A listed unit stands for itself and everything assigned to it on its OA sheet, adjusted by the 59.2 indicators. A formation entry stands for every counter on that OA sheet (garrisons, which have no single HQ)

under.description: The unit this entry's head starts under, where that is not its OA sheet's parent: a brigade that a Consists of roster puts in another division, given a roster of its own

alone.description: Only this counter (e.g. 'HQ only'), not its subordinates

toe.description: Only where the scenario gives a TOE other than the OA sheet's

trucks.description: First-line trucks for the units in this block (59.42)

count.description: How many dumps or supply units this block is (default 1). Unless pooled, ammo, fuel, stores and water are per dump or supply unit, so the block holds count times each

kind.description: air-facilities: a total to spread over the side's air facilities (59.52)

pooled.description: The supply figures are one pool for the whole block, shared out by the owner (the constraint gives any limits); without it they are each dump's or supply unit's own

air.description: Planes, pilots, SGSUs and air facilities (59.3); typed with the Air Game (Mission 7). Each plane entry (a list item with a type) carries aircraft_id, its tables/aircraft-characteristics.json row; check_data.py resolves it

facilities.description: Every air facility the side has at the start outside Malta: on the map, in its off-map boxes, and the ones it places

facility_levels.description: Malta's starting capacity in levels of 18 aircraft (44.14, R-165): a total the Commonwealth divides among the Maltese facilities (none above its standard level), or every facility at its standard level

levels.description: Facility levels this group fills, as printed in Graziani's SGSU column (R-165)

fleet.description: Naval units and where they start (30.0)

first_sail.description: No warship of this side moves before this OpStage; null: the scenario sets no limit. On every Commonwealth fleet block

reinforcements.description: Our sentences: how the schedule is used in this scenario

broken_down.description: Tank TOE points that start the scenario broken down (21.x), as rows

arrivals.description: Arrivals this scenario sets in place of the Reinforcement Schedule's (R-181): a unit named here comes by this row, and its schedule arrives rows do not apply in this scenario

arrival.description: Units that enter play at an OpStage in the placement's hexes, each with its OA sheet as in a set-up (59.2), in the arrival phase like a schedule row

trucks.description: First-line trucks that come with them

airFacility.description: One air facility (§36): a kind at a hex, a fixed facility by id, or so many of a kind the owner places within a placement

fixed.description: A tables/fixed-air-facilities.json id or a commonwealth_bases id of tables/air-off-map-distances.json

capacity.description: Starting capacity in squadrons when below the facility's maximum (36.0: airfield 6, strip 1, basin 3, alighting area 1; a fixed facility's printed maximum)

brokenDown.description: Either loose points in a repair facility (placement, weapon, points) or every tank point of the listed units and what is assigned to them (units, all_tanks)

points.description: TOE strength points, belonging to no unit

all_tanks.description: Every tank TOE point the units start with (their OA maximum unless the scenario says otherwise) is broken down, with its unit

repair_from.description: The first OpStage repair of these points may begin; null: at once

release.description: A release schedule (61.38, R-159): units that start in the from hexes may not leave them before first, and from then on at most per_opstage battalions a stage leave; an HQ leaves freely and every other land counter counts as one

first.description: The first OpStage any unit may leave

counts_as_one.description: Each of these, with everything attached or assigned to it, counts as one battalion

free.description: Units outside the limit, free to leave from an OpStage

formations.description: A formation with its own allowance, over and above per_opstage; its HQs leave freely

min_repaired.description: Share of the battalion's tank TOE points that must be repaired before it leaves

ports.description: Ports not at their listed efficiency

minefields.description: Every printed minefield hex; minefield_sets says whose

minefield_sets.description: Each side's set-up minefields: the listed hexes plus more's count of the owner's choice in its placement (or, with no hexes, sites in the set's own placement); real and dummy are counts over the whole set, the owner choosing which site is which. All start unrevealed

placement.description: With no hexes: where the set's fields go, in hexes a minefield could be built in (24.3x)

beyond.description: Only hexes more than this many hexes from of

up_to.description: real and dummy are maximums: the owner may lay fewer, or none

side.description: The player who chooses the hexes, on every row that leaves them to a player; absent where the row fills every hex it names

up_to.description: count is a maximum: the side may place fewer, or none (R-161). Absent: exactly count

roads_built.description: Our sentences naming the unfinished roads/railways already built

road_hexsides_built.description: Every unfinished-road hexside record (map/hexsides.json key) that starts the scenario as road; a seam hexside is both its edge records. Absent: none

railroad_hexsides_built.description: Every unfinished-railroad hexside record that starts the scenario as railroad, in order from the built line outward; a seam hexside is both its edge records. Absent: none

railroad_destroyed.description: Railroad hexes that start the scenario destroyed (24.6x)

pipeline_hexes_built.description: Water pipeline hexes (52.2x) on the map at set-up, in order outward from the source; railroad hexes acting as pipeline are not listed. Absent: none

railroad_pipeline_sources.description: Sides whose railroad hexes act as pipeline, each with the railroad hexes its water enters from; a side's railroad pipeline is the railroad hexes joined along the line to one of them. Absent: 52.22, every operating railroad hex is Commonwealth pipeline

any_hex.description: Holding any one hex of the place is enough

supplyTrace.description: Land-only reading of a supply line (R-110): a route of any length a medium truck could follow from the unit's hex to any one of these, free of enemy units and of enemy ZOC unless a friendly unit is in the hex

any_of.description: At least one of these as well

supply.description: Our sentence: the supply condition the holding units must meet

margins.description: Points victory: the level won by the side ahead, by margin of points

side.description: This side wins the band's level whoever is ahead (R-184: The Long Retreat's zero band)

ratios.description: Points victory by ratio (64.76): the side ahead wins the first row, top down, whose over its total divided by the other's exceeds; a total against zero takes the first row, equal totals the draw row

cut_off.description: Judged at the end, before the points: if no combat unit of side on the map has this trace, winner wins this level (R-185, 60.82)

toe_on_sheet.description: Failing every levels row, each side totals the TOE strength points of its land units in hexes of its named sheet at the end; the larger total wins this level (R-183, 63.91)

exclude.description: OA units whose points are not counted

hq.description: An HQ's own TOE points count

guns.description: Gun TOE points (artillery, anti-tank, anti-aircraft) count beside infantry and armour

broken_down.description: Broken-down tank points on the sheet, assigned to no unit, count for their owner

tie.description: Equal totals: no victory (draw), or this side wins the level

replaces.description: Each block given here replaces the same block of that side

adds.description: Blocks given here are added to that side's (SPI says 'in addition')
